script.source_monologue: I used to watch the sidewalk for someone arriving. That waiting cost me hours I never got back. The sidewalk stayed empty more nights than not. So I stopped paying attention with my whole chest. I still looked, but I no longer bled for it. That's a smaller price for the same window view. Attachment held anyway, quieter, cheaper, still mine. The sidewalk is still empty, and I'm still here. It cost less this time, and it stayed longer.
